summary: Writes a V back to a new save or, by the save's policy, over an existing one after copying it into the save backups.

faults.when: The save's policy is Never overwrite; the fix is to change this save's setting.
The save changed on disk since it was read.

lifetime: Per request, behind the write-back design's in-game gate.

x-friction.gap: Overwriting a save must happen once, after its backup copy, even across a crash.
x-friction.closes: Outside effects with an idempotency key and recorded outcome.
